LanguageData.QJ_FinisherSkillTip: Only pawns at or above this skill level are allowed to finish the work. Anyone may do the earlier crafting.
LanguageData.QJ_AutoBestTip: Checked: Only the best available finisher in the colony may complete this work, and the skill requirement follows that pawn automatically. Colonists who are away, downed, or busy still count as available for this comparison.\n\nUnchecked: Any pawn that meets the finisher skill you set may complete the work.
LanguageData.QJ_MigrationBody: Quality Jobs found {0} existing quality bill(s). They have been left unmanaged so they can continue with their current behavior. Shared unfinished work remains available either way.
LanguageData.QJ_MigrationEnableExisting: Enable Quality Jobs on existing bills for quality items?
LanguageData.QJ_MigrationEnableExistingTip: Checked: Existing bills use Quality Jobs with Auto-adjust finisher skill enabled. The best eligible colonist in the colony performs the finishing touch; temporarily unavailable colonists still count. Inspiration and production-specialist requirements are disabled, and low-quality results are not retried.\n\nUnchecked: Existing bills keep vanilla completion behavior. Sharing unfinished work is unaffected.
LanguageData.QJ_StockCapTooltip: The maximum number of unfinished items of this product. The cap is shared per product, so every bill producing this item counts against it.\n\n0 means unlimited.
LanguageData.QJ_StatusQueueTip: Unfinished: items in the sharing pool that any allowed crafter may continue. Waiting: paused items that need a qualifying finisher. Finishing: items assigned to a finisher.
LanguageData.QJ_StatusFinishersTip: Colonists on this map who currently qualify to perform the finishing touch, best candidate first. A colonist qualifies when the required work type is enabled and the finisher requirements above are met.\n\nDowned colonists, colonists in a mental state, and colonists away from this map do not count.
LanguageData.QJ_StatusStalled: Waiting items have no eligible finisher
LanguageData.QJ_StatusStalledTip: Unfinished items are waiting, but no colonist currently qualifies to finish them, so no finish jobs are being created.\n\nCheck the finisher skill requirement, the inspiration and specialist requirements, and whether the intended finisher has the work type enabled and is on this map. While stalled, the stock cap may also block new items from being started.
LanguageData.QJ_StatusStalledConstruction: No eligible finisher — build is stalled
LanguageData.QJ_StatusStalledConstructionTip: This building is paused waiting for a finishing touch, but no colonist currently qualifies, so it will not complete.\n\nCheck the finisher skill requirement, the inspiration and specialist requirements, and whether the intended builder has Construction enabled and is on this map.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsManageNewBillsTip: Checked: Quality Jobs manages quality-producing bills by default using the options in this column. Individual bills can override these options in their bill settings.\n\nUnchecked: Bills use vanilla behavior unless Quality Jobs has been enabled in the bill settings dialog.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsManageNewConstructionTip: Checked: New quality-producing buildings are managed automatically using the options in this column. Individual buildings can be configured or cleared with the Quality Job button.\n\nUnchecked: New buildings use vanilla behavior unless enabled individually.
LanguageData.QJ_RequireInspiredTip: Checked: Only a pawn with Inspired Creativity may perform the finishing touch; other pawns may do the earlier work. The inspiration is consumed on completion, as in vanilla.\n\nUnchecked: Inspired Creativity is not required.
LanguageData.QJ_RequireSpecialistTip: Checked: Only a pawn whose Ideology role grants a production quality bonus may perform the finishing touch; other pawns may do the earlier work.\n\nUnchecked: A production-specialist role is not required.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsFinisherSkillTip: Only pawns at or above this skill level may perform the finishing touch; other pawns may do the earlier work.\n\nWhen Auto-adjust finisher skill is checked, this value is kept as the manual default but is not used.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsShareWorkTip: Checked: Unfinished items are unlocked so any allowed pawn can continue work that someone else started.\n\nUnchecked: Vanilla behavior, where an unfinished item stays bound to the pawn who started it.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsHighPriorityFinishTip: Checked: A colonist chosen to finish an item takes that job the next time they look for work, before every other kind of work except firefighting, medical care, rescuing and bed rest. Their current job is not interrupted.\n\nUnchecked: The finish job is the first job within its work type, but work types the colonist ranks higher still come first.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsDefaultCapTip: Sets the default maximum number of unfinished items for each product. All bills producing the same item share the cap.\n\nBills stop starting new items when the cap is reached; in-progress items may still finish. 0 means unlimited.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsShowToolbarButtonTip: Adds a button beside the view toggles in the lower right corner of the screen. The button opens the Quality Jobs settings.
LanguageData.QJ_SettingsEnabledNote: The toggle applies to the loaded save. Disabling restores all items to vanilla and discards this save's Quality Jobs configuration.\n\nIf the mod stays installed, it re-activates with default settings the next time the save is loaded. Disable is meant as preparation for removing the mod.
LanguageData.QJ_DisableWarning:
Disabling restores all set-aside items to vanilla ownership and permanently discards Quality Jobs configuration for this save (bill conditions, stock caps). Saves made afterwards contain no trace of the mod, so this is the clean way to prepare for uninstalling.

Note: if you keep the mod installed, it will re-activate with default settings the next time you load this save.

Disable Quality Jobs?
LanguageData.QJ_NoGameLoaded: Load a save to change per-save behavior.
LanguageData.QJ_GizmoManageDesc: Manage this construction with Quality Jobs: pause completion until a qualifying builder exists, and optionally rebuild until a target quality is rolled.\n\nLeft-click toggles it on or off. Enabling applies your construction defaults. Right-click configures it.
LanguageData.QJ_RetriedUntilTip: The build is deconstructed and rebuilt until it rolls the selected quality or better, except when No retries is selected.\n\nSome materials are lost on each retry.
LanguageData.QJ_BillTargetQualityTip: When a finished item rolls below this quality, the bill count is raised by one so a replacement is produced. The item itself is kept.\n\nThis applies to bills set to make a fixed number of items; the other repeat modes already decide for themselves when to stop.
